content: Make sure plugin marketplace is updated

goal: Verify .claude-plugin/marketplace.json's per-plugin descriptions still match the current plugin.json descriptions, since pmcro-trail's description evolved (Trail-as-Product framing, frame-schema mention) after marketplace.json was first written; fix any drift.

steps.action: diff marketplace.json entries against both plugins' plugin.json descriptions

success_criteria: every marketplace.json plugin entry's description matches its plugin.json description
out_of_scope: adding other marketplace mirrors (.cursor-plugin, .codex-plugin, etc.) — none exist in this fresh repo and none were asked for
